_doc: Registry of code patches. Each id needs a locator in tools/boot.py:PATCHES. Record: id, scope (testbed|release), function, problem, change, validation case ids.

patches.problem: Dev console/admin hotkeys are reset to off at every launch
patches.change: Bool false -> true before SetField isAdmin (1 byte per boot file)

patches.problem: No AI decision visibility in release build
patches.change: Appended logger/describer/wrapper functions; redirected call sites (tools/inject.py EVENTS + testbed/ailog.json traces)

patches.problem: Vanilla AI has no army awareness: never attacks or contests exposed armies, retreats/heals by distance only, re-rolls its retreat threshold every tick, sieges adjacent villages in parallel; its getUnits busy filter crashes on non-structure Military orders
patches.change: tools/behave.py rules: hunt (Military ArmyFight on an AIEntityGroup; chases and contests of village sieges near our land; supply budget; objective switch), safe-heal (3 healing-key closures wrapped), retreat-terrain (2 getWarzonePowerBalance calls wrapped; balance x terrain x supply), annex-spacing (tryAction->tryArmyAction wrapped), busy-siege (1 op NullCheck->JNull in the getUnits busy closure); undeploy (installed F_Special_2 on hostile land: tryUndeploy(false) + stale noMoveAbilities removed); ability-gate (3 tryUseOrderAbilities balance calls wrapped: 1.0 = no enemy -> no emergency abilities); peace-gate (the tradeRequestReceived call site wrapped: a treaty offer from an at-war faction is refused while our Military order on its structure is in Engage/Action); raid scans every at-war owner's villages (press-target wrapper, map rscan); added ObjectMap globals for state; worm-flee (worm-targeted armies on sand stop their order and move to the nearest rock; Army.playDeathWorm call in Sandworm.tryAttack wrapped to log weaten); pick-life (getUnits calls in tryArmyAction / checkStructures / checkWorldEvents wrapped: armies < 50% life and not fighting removed); no-regen-heal (the Resupply getUnits call in checkUnits wrapped: armies without safe regen and with full supply removed); annex value (Annex target scores: special +30, compactness, x cheapest/cost via getOccupationActionCost, first spice x2 except Fremen/Vernius); Fremen deep-desert ring bonus in the Annex score; desert-step (siege / raid armies draining in the deep desert next to the target move onto the village's side); gather (Engage leaders wait for the pack: checkEngageOrder getActionDesc call wrapped); Fremen ring hold (aimod_ddclean: off-ring Annex candidates dropped while an uncontested ring is open; raid / pillage press skip ring villages); worm hold (worm-moved armies out of vanilla Resupply / mission picks while a worm is near); harvester run (outgunned harvester to a safe field); hunt awareness (capturing armies count half in aimod_react; armed group member first); disengage (Resupply armies fighting a powerless target pulled out); desert-step Engage/Action only; gather never waits for a fleeing prey or in the deep desert; rally (outmatched defenders gather at one point instead of piecemeal fights; heal / flee spots next to the danger off limits); siege position (capture off enemy guns); main-base guns x3 in power measures; discovery relaunch gap; raid waits for a full Annex gauge; unstick (siege army stuck in the village footprint walked to its safe position); keep-capture (5 findRelocationPos calls in unitMicroManagement wrapped: no defender Reposition for an army at a village we besiege / occupy); bunker redirect yields to Fremen ring villages; transit hold (hunt / raid not re-judged in transit); raid refuse logs nearer refused candidates; lone Annex candidate drop; retreat commit + side; contact tension (contest entry); threat busy / outside-land weighting; raider sieges contested; Fremen one-ring focus (nearest clean deep desert); heal / retreat / strand safety on the undiscounted threat; raid protects the top 3 Annex choices and skips villages behind another faction's main base; siege retry block backs off 30 -> 240 s; home-ring defense (neutral village next to our main base under enemy capture = defend; walking Annexes released); hunt: enemy main base defense weighs in near it, supply crush waiver timed; fight retreat `trivial`; tension gate (capped contact partner listed for Annex / Pillage, refused launches cool it); rally on active threats only; stuck targets (repeated orderless launches) leave the target list for 2-8 min; sietch zones +10 Annex value; raid's Annex-gauge hold times out after 20 s; sietch / renegade-base strikes (PillageSietch / Dismantle) pass the Liberate / Raze trip-cost gate; a lasting `exposed` refusal decays the gauge (Skip) instead of re-firing every 0.5 s; contests start no lower than DEF_HOPE_IN x their side (objective abort uses the same floor); raider-siege contests / neutral hunts target raiders only, besieger falls back to the occupier; raid `weak` abort = launch test x ABORT / ENTER; hunt `nogroup` log; hunt start score threat / (distance + 100)^2 with contests always first; safe-heal / strand judge ownerless heal structures (allied sietches) for the asking faction (aimod_unsafe 4th arg); far-annex (isInSupplyRange in getSiegeableVillages: + FAR_ZONES for factions without Annex distance cost); micro-owner (unitMicroManagement call sites wrapped: map umf = the faction whose micro runs; the fight-retreat heal key judges ownerless structures for it); contest size floor in the candidate test; minor contests (non-own village > CONTEST_NEAR) without contest priority or objective abort; aimod_sieged: raider sieges only of neutral / own villages
